reasons.correctness: getTicketStats checks admin, throws ValidationTranslatableException with error.validation.invalid_date_range, and calls countByStatusAndCreatedTimeBetween with atStartOfDay and plusDays(1). Every status is present in the map. Hidden tests pass 5/5.
reasons.convention_fit: The endpoint has @PreAuthorize ADMIN and inherits the class-level @RateLimit. The DTO is TicketStatsDtoOut. The new key is in messages_en and messages_pl. No field injection was added. Code stays in the support/ticket package.
reasons.design_fit: Logic sits in the service and the query in a derived repository method. The controller declares adminUid but never uses it, copied from a neighbour. The service adds a redundant explicit TicketStatsDtoOut import next to the dtos.* wildcard.
reasons.test_quality: The nested GetTicketStatsTests in the Mockito-only SupportTicketServiceUnitTest covers non-admin denial, the from>to message key, and the exact start/end arguments with all statuses. The denial test does not assert the permission message key.
reasons.graph_use: One graph query listed the support/ticket files before the agent read them. It then found the exception, message keys and test file with grep, find and glob. The graph was not used for dependents or an existing endpoint example.
